// so it survives a crash or a reload. Device info, every launcher step, every
// error. Shown (and copyable) from the error card on the loading screen.
(function () {
  if (window.Journal) return;

  var str = function (a) {
    if (a && a.stack) return a.stack;
    if (a && typeof a === "object") { try { return JSON.stringify(a); } catch (e) { return String(a); } }
    return String(a);
  };
  window.Journal = function () {
    var s = Array.prototype.map.call(arguments, str).join(" ");
    buf.push(new Date().toISOString().slice(11, 23) + " " + s.slice(0, 1500));
    buf.length > 300 && buf.splice(0, buf.length - 300);
    save();
  };
  window.Transcript = function () { return buf.join("\n"); };
  window.Faults = 0;
  var _ho = null;
  try { _ho = window.__Handoff || JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem("rl_handoff") || "null"); } catch (e) {}

    Journal("=== REDLINE open", location.protocol === "file:" ? "(local file)" : location.origin);
    Journal("ua", navigator.userAgent);

// Boot: the cover's bar eases toward a target (capped at 96 until done);
// done() fills it and fades the cover out, show() brings it back
(function () {
  // handed over from the launcher (it downloaded / unpacked this page under the
  // very same cover): carry on from its bar, already showing, no second fade
  var H = window.__Handoff || null;
  // the page swap can drop window globals, so the launcher also leaves it in sessionStorage
  try { H = H || JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem("rl_handoff") || "null"); sessionStorage.removeItem("rl_handoff"); } catch (e) {}
  H && Date.now() - (H.at || 0) > 60000 && (H = null);
  window.__Handoff = H;
  var floor = H ? H.p : 0;
  var MIN = 5000, t0 = 0, shown = false, root = document.getElementById("brand-load"), fill = root.querySelector("#ld-fill"), want = floor, cur = floor, run = false, hideT = 0;
  if (H) { root.classList.add("ld-in"); fill.style.width = floor.toFixed(1) + "%"; }
  // the version being opened (the launcher knows it before the game arrives)
  window.Stamp = function (v) { var e = root.querySelector(".ld-ver"); v && e && (e.textContent = "Redline " + v); };
  H && H.ver && window.Stamp(H.ver);
  function tick() {
    if (want < 90 && !root.classList.contains("ld-done")) want += 0.02;
    // first load: the bar keeps pace with the 5 s show, never running ahead of it
    var shownWant = want;
    if (!shown) {
      var f = Math.min(1, (performance.now() - t0) / MIN);
      shownWant = Math.min(want === 100 ? 100 : 96, Math.max(want * f, 90 * f), 96 * f + (want === 100 && f >= 1 ? 4 : 0));
    }
    if (!shown) shownWant = Math.max(shownWant, floor);
    cur += (shownWant - cur) * 0.07;
    if (Math.abs(shownWant - cur) < 0.15) cur = shownWant;
    fill.style.width = cur.toFixed(1) + "%";
    run = root.isConnected && !root.classList.contains("ld-done");
    if (run) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  function go() { if (!run) { run = true; requestAnimationFrame(tick); } }
  window.Boot = {
    set: function (p) { if (typeof p === "number") want = Math.max(want, Math.min(96, floor + (p * (96 - floor)) / 96)); },
    cur: function () { return cur; },
    done: function () {
      // the first load always shows for at least MIN ms
      var wait = shown ? 0 : Math.max(0, MIN - (performance.now() - t0));
      clearTimeout(hideT);
      hideT = setTimeout(function () { want = 100; shown = true; hideT = setTimeout(function () { root.classList.add("ld-done"); if (!window.__Booted) { window.__Booted = true; window.dispatchEvent(new Event("rlbootdone")); } }, 650); }, wait);
    },
    show: function () {
      clearTimeout(hideT); want = 0; cur = 0; fill.style.width = "0%";
      root.classList.remove("ld-done"); root.classList.add("ld-in"); go();
    },
  };
  go();
  H || setTimeout(function () { root.classList.add("ld-in"); }, 500);
  // the error card (the launcher uses it too)
  var err = document.getElementById("rl-err");
  err.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
    var b = ev.target.closest("button"); if (!b) return;
    var pre = err.querySelector("pre");
    if (b.dataset.a === "retry") location.reload();
    else if (b.dataset.a === "det") { err.classList.toggle("det"); pre.textContent = Transcript().split("\n").slice(-60).join("\n"); pre.scrollTop = pre.scrollHeight; b.textContent = err.classList.contains("det") ? "Hide details" : "Show details"; }
    else if (b.dataset.a === "copy") {
      var s = Transcript();
      (navigator.clipboard ? navigator.clipboard.writeText(s) : Promise.reject()).then(function () { b.textContent = "Copied"; }, function () {
        err.classList.add("det"); pre.textContent = s;
        var r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(pre); getSelection().removeAllRanges(); getSelection().addRange(r);
        b.textContent = "Selected: copy it";
      });
    }
  });
  window.Abort = function (title, msg) {
    if (root.classList.contains("ld-done")) return;
    Journal("FAIL", title, "-", msg);
    err.querySelector("b").textContent = title; err.querySelector("span").textContent = msg;
    root.classList.add("ld-in", "ld-failed"); requestAnimationFrame(function () { err.classList.add("on"); });
  };
  if (window.__Legacy) Abort("This browser can't run REDLINE", "WebGL 2 isn't available. Update Chrome or ChromeOS, and make sure hardware acceleration is on in Settings.");
  // still loading long after it should be: say so, with the log
  var started = performance.now();
  (function watch() {
    if (window.__Booted || root.classList.contains("ld-done") || root.classList.contains("ld-failed")) return;
    var s = (performance.now() - started) / 1000;
    if ((window.Faults > 0 && s > 45) || s > 150) return Abort("REDLINE stopped loading", window.Faults > 0 ? "Something went wrong while starting the game. Copy the log and send it over." : "This is taking much longer than it should. Try again, or copy the log and send it over.");
    setTimeout(watch, 2000);
  })();
})();
